summary: Amanat Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on May 18, 2026. The SPAC issued 7,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at $10.00 per share, generating $75 million in gross proceeds; the underwriter has a 45-day option for up to 1,125,000 additional shares. Key agreements include an underwriting agreement with Leerink Partners, a letter agreement with sponsor Amanat Sponsor Holdings LLC, and trust, registration rights, private placement, and administrative services agreements. The proceeds will be held in trust pending a business combination. Watch for the target acquisition announcement and deal structure.
